items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Maria gets her to go. Maria is like the mother of everybody on the set. So she says, I come on the stage over to this scene... Bess says, 'No, guess I'll stay home.' ... 'why you are hanging around this place for Why with your looks, Bess, and your way with the boys'

ctx.x: "Come on Bess." She says, "Take that stuff

away, nigger."
Then I say,
"All right, I'll leave you here"
Then I kiss the happy dust in the little
package and I put it on the stoop. I say,
"All right, I'll leave you here
Maybe you'll change your mind"
And off I go to my turn and the music is
playing and it finishes the song and off I go.
And just as I get off stage, Bess comes back
to reach for the happy dust and the curtain
falls. And it tied the show up in a country knot.
That's the end of that second
scene.
Now, the next to the finale
scene is when I got…
she says, I come on the stage over to this scene, singing, "Hello, Bess, going to the picnic?"
